pages.text: Craft the pick early. Right-click stone and it tells you what ore is nearby and roughly where. Walk, tap, walk, tap. It never breaks.$(br2)Geolosys hands you its own $(bold)Field Manual$() on first join. It lists every deposit, what it drops and at what depth.
Tap exposed stone, not dirt. In deepslate it reads deeper deposits. Pair it with a depth meter.
Lost the manual? Craft one. The depth meter reads your Y.

$(bold)Metals you will need, in order:$() copper and iron (homestead; iron is common and shallow), then $(bold)zinc$() (brass needs it, and brass needs a Blueprint), then gold and coal in bulk once machines run.$(br2)The first player to find zinc should tell everyone. That is a trade route being born.
